manual_verification: Verify real Amazon US product, market, keyword, Top-10 concentration, and CPC data through a read-only SellerSprite capability using a consistent node and window.
Use SIF only to verify natural/paid traffic structure and advertising dependency; do not use it as complete market-demand proof.
Verify real 1688 quotations, MOQ, unit weight, lead time, roller durability, and cleanability with supplier samples.
Verify platform fees, FBA and inbound freight, advertising, returns, taxes, compliance, infringement risk, and the complete cash cycle before purchasing or launching.
notes: All numeric evidence is fictional synthetic evaluation data collected on 2026-07-12; live SellerSprite, SIF, and Sorftime query paths were not verified.
SellerSprite evidence was limited to product, market, keyword, concentration, and CPC analysis. Estimated sales were not treated as Amazon official sales, and CPC was not treated as conversion.
SIF evidence was limited to traffic structure and advertising-dependency assessment and did not increase the demand score.
The 42% figure is known-cost-basis margin, not actual margin.
The only learned rule has status proposed and TikTok scope, so it did not affect Amazon scoring.
